blurb: Guests experience various types of Thai massage including traditional Thai massage, Swedish Thai massage, and signature blends that combine massage techniques with herbal compresses and oils. The massages aim to relax the body, relieve tension, and promote well-being. Services are provided by licensed and insured therapists with over 10 years of experience.
extraNote: Arrive 5-10 minutes early for intake and preparation · Late arrivals may result in shortened sessions with no refund · Cancel or reschedule with at least 2 hours notice · No shows without notice will be blocked from future bookings · Clients may adjust pressure, temperature, music volume, or stop massage within first 15 minutes without charge · Sexual interaction or discussion is prohibited and results in immediate termination and full payment · Gift certificates are non-refundable and must be presented at time of service · At one of three locations: 518 Taylor St San Francisco, 39 Polk St San Francisco, or 1535 Olympic Blvd, 2nd Floor, Walnut Creek
